image_description: A street-level view of a commercial bakery storefront. The facade features a large, curved glass display window filled with shelves of baked goods (breads, pastries) illuminated by warm interior lighting. To the left is a glass door entrance with posted notices. Above the window is a white sign with stylized text reading 'Boulangerie' and other script. The building exterior appears to be stucco or painted masonry. There is some graffiti on the upper wall section above the shop signage.
